name: Sleuth
summary: A deductive whodunit where players interrogate opponents to deduce the one hidden gem card from 36 combinations.
rules_text: Shuffle 36 Gem cards (gem x type x color) and hide one as the Missing Gem. Deal remaining face down: 11/8/7/5/5 for 3/4/5/6/7 players; any leftovers are revealed to all then set aside. Each player records own hand secretly. Shuffle 54 Search cards and deal 4 face up to each; rest is draw pile. On your turn you may either discard all 4 Search cards to draw 4 new, or interrogate one opponent with one Search card: One-Element asks opponent to announce publicly how many gems they have with that element; Two-Element opponent must privately show you all gems matching both elements while announcing the count publicly; Free Choice cards let you name any element(s). Record info, return any shown cards, discard used Search card and draw one. At any time you may guess the Missing Gem; if right you win, if wrong you are eliminated from guessing but still answer questions. Game ends when solved.
